literary_activities: His books / articles are taught in Santhali curriculum of Burdwan University, Vidyasagar University, North Odisha University and PSC syllabus. He was a member of the Santhali Advisory Board of Sahitya Akademi. He has authored a total of 28 dramas (play). His dramas have been broadcasted from AIR, Kolkata and DD Santali. He has translated a Bengali Novel ‘Anubhab’ by Dibyendu Palit into Santhali named ‘Anaikau’ in 2013. Besides these, he has acted in a Santhali feature Film ‘Sita Nalare Sagun Supari’ in 2005.
